title: RAW_UNSCREENED: shey als Textanapher oder Deixis
summary: RAW_UNSCREENED: f111v.17 solkain shey okaiin ... and .18 shey otain can link a prior written referent or introduce a new deictic object.

design.scope_description: Only already exposed source lines and cached report outputs; no new selectors, images or reserves.
design.mechanism: Anaphoric reading binds repeated shey to a written prior; deictic reading treats each as local demonstrative.
design.unit: Exact whole-form occurrences at the named loci.
design.prediction: Anaphora predicts one stable antecedent through .17-.19; deixis predicts independent local referents without identity chain.
concrete_observations: GDT939 gives shey between solkain and okaiin at .17; .18 has shey otain; .19 repeats qokain shey qokain.
linked_consequences: Every anaphoric shey needs a written antecedent; every deictic shey needs a written host without forced identity.
design.distinguishing_observation: Require one fixed antecedent policy and inspect exact intervening otain/host positions; no proximity-only credit.
design.strongest_likely_failure: The repeated form has no independent identity marker and both readings can preserve the lines.
